ios.desc:
TickerBar: Your Ultimate Stock, Crypto & Forex Ticker

Stay ahead of the markets with TickerBar, the sleek and powerful stock ticker app designed to keep you informed about stocks, cryptocurrency prices, Forex currency pairs, and commodities at a glance. Perfect for investors, traders, or anyone curious about the financial world, TickerBar offers a seamless, updated experience tailored to your needs.

Key Features:

• Updated Market Updates, effortlessly track the prices and performance of your favorite stocks, cryptocurrencies, commodities, and major Forex pairs, including markets from NYSE, NASDAQ, and TSX/TSXV, plus commodities like gold, silver, and oil. View updated data, including current prices and percentage changes, all in one streamlined interface.

• Supports ETFs

• Support indexes 
	• Dow Jones (DOW)
	• Nasdaq (NASDAQ)
	• S&P 500 (S&P)
	• Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX)
	• DAX (DAX)
	• FTSE 100 (FTSE)
	• Hang Seng (HSI)
	• Nikkei 225 (N225)

• Customizable Displa, make the ticker truly yours:
	• Adjust the font style, size, and speed to match your preferences.
	• Use up/down arrows for quick visual cues on market trends.
	• Enjoy a design that fits your workflow, whether you prefer subtle or bold displays.
	• Use the Shortcuts App

• Automate launching TickerBar when you put your iPhone on charge, saving you time and effort.
• Dark Mode Support, Switch to a dark mode interface for a more comfortable experience, particularly in low-light environments.
• Similar to Standby Mode, Get a handy at-a-glance experience reminiscent of the latest Standby mode introduced in iOS, so you can always stay connected to the markets.

Transform Your Screen into a Powerful Market Dashboard and Stock Ticker!

TickerBar is more than just a stock ticker, it’s your personal financial assistant. With its customizable features and smooth performance, it’s the ultimate tool to keep you informed and in control, now with support for live Forex currency pairs.
New: Now includes Crypto and Stock Fear & Greed Index sentiment, plus live stock market open/closed status for quick market context.

Download TickerBar today and take your market tracking to the next level!

Upgrade to TickerBar Pro to remove ads & unlock all features. Subscriptions will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Subscription is offered for 1-year and 1-month periods ($49.99/year, $4.99/month, price may vary by location), and will automatically renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours
